objective: Earn a paid NameCoach/Euphonia voice-AI take-home or trial by presenting the strongest public pronunciation and multilingual-ASR work without claiming production G2P experience.

source_need.title: Founding Voice AI Engineer
source_need.eligibility: San Francisco or remote; contract or part-time
source_need.published_rate: approximately USD 30-120 per hour by seniority
source_need.published_process: paid take-home followed by a paid trial month before any longer engagement
source_need.requested_depth: Grapheme-to-phoneme, IPA, ASR/TTS internals, and model building and evaluation, especially recognition and G2P.
source_need.policy: The employer-authored post remained public and invited a short email, but no closing date or independent current-status confirmation was available. The rate and process are not an offer, contract, payment, or revenue.

supported_now: An open-source English, Mandarin, and Cantonese L/N pronunciation coach
Onset and spectral feature analysis, cautious calibration, explainable scoring, and a Whisper fallback
A mixed-language Whisper, Silero VAD, Lingua, and subtitle-refinement pipeline
not_proven: A provider-neutral TTS pronunciation middleware deployment
A large expert-rated pronunciation evaluation corpus
fit.claim_boundary: The public repositories prove relevant pronunciation UX, signal analysis, and multilingual ASR work. They do not prove the production G2P depth requested by the role.

application.method: One concise email to the address published in the employer's Hacker News post
application.delivery_evidence: The reviewed compose window closed after one send, and the exact subject appeared in the visible Sent mailbox.
application.policy: Do not infer interest from delivery. Any reply, take-home scope, overlap requirement, rate, trial, contract, payment, or source transfer must be reviewed on its own evidence.
